offence_note: Manslaughter by careless use of sawed-off shotgun
sentence_quote: I consider that a fit sentence is one of seven years.
note: Lifetime s. 109 prohibition; credit of two years given at less than two-for-one.

offence_note: Manslaughter with firearm, robbery with firearm, break and enter with robbery
sentence_quote: the sentence on count 1 be reduced to 8 years, 335 days with credit granted of 3 years, 30 days
note: Appeal by consent only to raise pre-sentence credit to 1.5:1 under Summers.

offence_note: Trafficking fentanyl, possession for trafficking, possession of proceeds
sentence_quote: the custodial portion of the appellant’s sentence is reduced to 20 months
note: Seven months already served; 13 months remain. Appellant described as an addict.

offence_note: Importing and trafficking about 112 kilos of cocaine
sentence_quote: While leave to appeal sentence is granted, the appeal is dismissed.
note: Length of sentence under appeal not stated.

offence_note: Conspiracy to facilitate terrorist activity; participation in terrorist group
sentence_quote: As I have found no error in principle and have concluded that the sentence imposed was not demonstrably unfit, there is no basis to interfere with the 12 year sentence Mr. Ahmed received
note: Crown and offender cross-appeals dismissed; credit covers pre-sentence custody and bail conditions; parole under CCRA.

offence_note: Discharging firearm with intent, aggravated assault, firearm possession offences
sentence_quote: it is my view that the proper sentence for the discharging offence is seven years imprisonment. This produces a total sentence of eight years imprisonment for the Hamilton offences
note: Victim surcharges set aside; Thunder Bay sentence separate; 5y 314d effective on discharging count.

offence_note: Assault, obstruction, failure to appear, stolen property, driving while disqualified, dangerous driving
sentence_quote: The trial judge acceded to the Crown’s position and imposed a global three-year sentence.
note: 63 days pre-sentence custody; appeal court says reduced sentence already reflected plea, COVID and custody.

offence_note: Attempted murder, break and enter, dangerous driving, leaving scene, threats
sentence_quote: allow the appeal to the extent that the sentence on Count 1 be reduced to 9 years, 10.5 months, reflecting total credit of 4 years, 1.5 months for pre-sentence custody
note: Total before credit computed: 14 years on count 1 plus 1y 6m consecutive on count 5.

sentence_quote: The judge sentenced the appellant to 10 months in prison followed by 14 months probation.
note: Closing shown is Finch CJ dissent; majority (Lowry) said incarceration necessary, so appeal inferred dismissed.

offence_note: Robbery by threat; SPIO status for dangerous offender application
sentence_quote: I would grant the application and order that Mr. Steele be remanded for assessment pursuant to s. 752.1(1).
note: SCC ruling on dangerous offender assessment gateway; no sentence fixed.

sentence_quote: set aside the six month sentence of imprisonment and substitute a four months conditional sentence on the terms proposed in the joint submission.
note: Joint submission of four-month conditional sentence restored; firearms prohibition not disturbed.

offence_note: Breach of conditional sentence order conditions
sentence_quote: I am collapsing it and he will have to serve the remainder of his time.
note: S. 742.6 breach ruling; remaining 522 days of 21-month conditional sentence served in custody.
